name: Cool Cat Stroll
look: A photo of a gray tabby kitten walking upright on its hind legs across a parquet wood floor, one front paw raised and head tilted up as if strutting proudly, with a dark wooden table and a brick wall behind it.
use: Shows someone strolling away smug and carefree. The caption describes a small personal victory or getting away with something, and the kitten's proud two-legged walk is the confident exit.
examples: Me walking out of the dentist
after hiding the last cookie for later
describe: kitten walking on two legs like a person
small cat strutting upright across a wooden floor
tabby kitten standing on its hind legs taking a walk
cat walking like a human with total confidence
little cat sashaying with one paw in the air
